# Blog posts have no route on neomjs.com: the SEO generator never emits them

## Context

The 13.2 posts (#19492, #19498) and the outbound experiment (D#19500) need one shareable, indexable URL per post. Measured on 2026-10-09 at 14:20Z:
- **The sitemap has no blog routes.** `https://neomjs.com/sitemap.xml` lists 18,133 URLs, none of them a blog route.
- **Blog paths 404 where release paths serve.** `https://neomjs.com/news/blog/the-salute` and `/news/blog/blog/the-salute` return 404, while `/news/releases/13.1.0` returns 200.
- **The hash route is the only way in.** A post is reachable only through the portal's `#/news/blog/<id>`.

This is the second sighting. The first is on #9849 (2026-09-15, its AC-3), recorded there as a defect-note and never promoted.

## The Problem

A post is invisible to search and to anything that fetches its URL. Of the 15 `blog.json` posts, 0 are routable. The 13.2 posts would ship the same way, so whatever the outbound experiment shares lands on the portal's front door, not on the post.

## The Architectural Reality

- **No blog collector.** `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` (at `77e3df4272`) builds the route list in `collectAllRoutes` from seven sources:
  - top-level routes;
  - `learn/tree.json` (`collectRoutesFromTree`);
  - examples, release notes, issues, PRs and discussions.

  `learn/tree.json` holds 0 `blog/` entries. The portal's blog navigation is `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json`, with 15 leaves.
- **Design authority.** The surface contradicts itself. The generator's own `PRIORITIES` map (L72–80) assigns 0.9 to nine `blog/*` ids that no collector ever emits. #9849's distribution premise reads "Publish as markdown in `learn/blog/` (SSG+ indexable via neomjs.com)".
- **Pipeline.** `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` and `llms.txt` are generated (`buildScripts/docs/rebuildContentIndexesAndSeo.mjs`) and committed by `.github/workflows/data-sync-pipeline.yml`. The site repository copies `sitemap.xml`, `llms.txt`, `robots.txt` and `index.html` from `neo.mjs/dist/production/apps/portal` (`neomjs/pages` `buildScripts/enhanceSeo.mjs`).
- **Inference, to confirm in the fix:** the site answers 200 only for routes the generated index knows (`/news/releases/13.1.0` serves, `/news/blog/…` does not). The PR confirms which route form the server maps to a post before choosing the emitted id.

## The Fix

1. **`collectBlogRoutes()` in `generate.mjs`.** It reads `blog.json`'s leaves and emits each post at the portal's blog route, using its `path` for `lastmod`. It is wired into `collectAllRoutes`, the sitemap and `llms.txt`'s blog section. A leaf whose `path` is missing fails, naming the leaf.
2. **No dead entries in `PRIORITIES`.** Blog routes get one rule, for example the recency tiers release notes already use (`getReleaseNotePriority`), in place of the nine hard-coded ids.
3. **`Generate.spec.mjs` pins it:** every `blog.json` leaf appears in the sitemap, and a missing post file fails by name.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 The generated sitemap lists every `blog.json` leaf at the post's route, with a `lastmod`.
- [ ] AC-2 `llms.txt` lists the posts in its blog section.
- [ ] AC-3 `PRIORITIES` holds no id the generator cannot emit.
- [ ] AC-4 `Generate.spec.mjs` covers AC-1 and the missing-file failure.
- [ ] AC-5 (post-merge, after the site's next pipeline run) A post's route on neomjs.com answers 200 with the post's content.

## Out of Scope

- **Per-route social-card metadata.** Every page served today carries the site-wide card (`og:title` "Neo.mjs - Self-Evolving Software Organism" on `/` and on `/news/releases/13.1.0`). That is the site template's surface, captured as a defect-note.
- Cross-posting (#9849's dev.to AC) and the outbound gate (D#19500).
